source_frame: Native X points toward motor rear and maps to installed enclosure +Y.
selected_regions: Green motor/cylinder and its fixed rail ends only. Blue tip unused; red middle/head underside excluded.
motion_scope: Native head X[-7,0] bounds the red portion that can pass the forward stop through the designed axial free play. Vertical admission only raises the body and preserves these bounds.
method: Exact minima of piecewise ruled-section lower envelopes below Z19: axial span endpoints, vertex/height crossings and stationary roots of each rational edge/height intersection. Other head components use their retained conservative bounds.
